---
title: "Cell-to-gene"
output: html_document
---

## 读取

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

input_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Projects/scRhythmBayes_simulation/output/scRITMO_extended_simulation/sigma_gradient_1p5_2p5_3p5_4p5_5p5_6p5_empirical_fixed_v1/R_input"
out <- path.expand("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/R/c2g")
dir.create(file.path(out, "data"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out, "fig"), showWarnings = FALSE)

fit <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "cell_to_gene_phase_sensitivity/gene_level_phase_sensitivity_fits.rds"))
post <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "phase_uncertainty/phase_Q.rds"))
truth <- read.csv(file.path(dirname(input_dir), "gene_truth.csv"))
meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "metadata.csv"))

truth <- truth %>%
  dplyr::filter(tolower(is_seed) != "true", !gene_id %in% post$seed) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene = gene_id, celltype,
                   Rhythmic = tolower(true_rhythmic) == "true",
                   true_phase_rad, true_amplitude)

est <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  "True phase" = fit[["Oracle true phase"]]$param_long,
  "Phase only" = fit[["Predicted phase + uniform weight"]]$param_long,
  "Phase + r_cell" = fit[["Current SRB phase + r_cell"]]$param_long,
  "Sample ZT" = fit[["ZT-only + uniform weight"]]$param_long,
  .id = "Method"
)
```

## 计算

```{r}
methods <- c("True phase", "Phase only", "Phase + r_cell", "Sample ZT")

dat <- tidyr::crossing(truth, Method = methods) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(est, by = c("gene", "celltype", "Method")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(meta, celltype, sigma_bio_hour), by = "celltype") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = methods),
    Detected = is.finite(FDR) & FDR < 0.05,
    Phase_error = abs(atan2(sin(Phase - true_phase_rad),
                            cos(Phase - true_phase_rad))) * 24/(2*pi),
    Amp_error = abs(Amplitude_shrunk - true_amplitude)
  )

res <- dat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Method, celltype, sigma_bio_hour) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Genes = dplyr::n(), N_rhythmic = sum(Rhythmic),
    TP = sum(Detected & Rhythmic), FP = sum(Detected & !Rhythmic),
    Power = TP / N_rhythmic,
    Phase_MAE = mean(Phase_error[Rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    Amp_MAE = mean(Amp_error[Rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    FDP = FP / pmax(TP + FP, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(dat, file.path(out, "data/c2g_gene.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res, file.path(out, "data/c2g.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
res
```

## 作图

```{r, fig.width=8.2677, fig.height=5.8465}
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(12, "pt"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)))

col <- c("True phase" = "#202020", "Phase only" = "#D18C6D",
         "Phase + r_cell" = "#A43B3B", "Sample ZT" = "#919191")
shp <- c("True phase" = 16, "Phase only" = 1, "Phase + r_cell" = 17, "Sample ZT" = 15)

p1 <- ggplot(res, aes(sigma_bio_hour, Power * 100, colour = Method, shape = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col) + scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6 + 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Detection power", x = "Phase dispersion (h)", y = "Power (%)")

p2 <- ggplot(res, aes(sigma_bio_hour, Phase_MAE, colour = Method, shape = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col) + scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6 + 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Acrophase error", x = "Phase dispersion (h)", y = "MAE (h)")

p3 <- ggplot(res, aes(sigma_bio_hour, Amp_MAE, colour = Method, shape = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col) + scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6 + 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Amplitude error", x = "Phase dispersion (h)", y = "MAE")

p4 <- ggplot(res, aes(sigma_bio_hour, FDP * 100, colour = Method, shape = Method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = 2, colour = "#B8B8B8", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col) + scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6 + 0.5) +
  labs(title = "False discoveries", x = "Phase dispersion (h)", y = "FDP (%)")

p <- (p1 + p2 + p3 + p4) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p
```

## 保存

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig/c2g.pdf"), p, width = 210, height = 148.5, units = "mm",
       device = "pdf", family = "Helvetica", useDingbats = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig/c2g.svg"), p, width = 210, height = 148.5, units = "mm",
       device = svglite::svglite)
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig/c2g.png"), p, width = 210, height = 148.5, units = "mm",
       dpi = 300, device = ragg::agg_png)
saveRDS(p, file.path(out, "fig/c2g.rds"))
```
